title: Find the Longest Substring Containing Vowels in Even Counts
goal: Find the longest substring in which each vowel occurs an even number of times.
strategy: A five-bit prefix mask records vowel-count parity. Equal masks at two prefix boundaries mean every vowel changed an even number of times between them; keep each mask earliest index for maximum length.
